note: Per-item selector and executor state. Held-out sidecars are withheld: they would expose the difficulty structure and identifier space of the unreleased partition. Every public-partition analysis in the paper is recomputable from this plus the matrices.

fields.candidate_count: size of the candidate pool the selector scored over
fields.selected_count: functions actually injected into the prompt
fields.parser_status: restricted-AST validator verdict on the generated program
fields.direct: state of the Direct call, which is the only input the gate sees: predicted letter, parser and executor verdict, error code, token counts, latency and HTTP attempts
